content.value_statement: AI agent projects often need structured steps for design, tools, memory, orchestration, and evaluation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a phased workflow for practical agent development.
actual_capabilities: Defines phases for agent design, implementation, orchestration, tool integration, memory, and evaluation.
Guides selection of agent purpose, capabilities, tools, memory design, and success metrics.
Separates single-agent, multi-agent, and workflow orchestration work into clear steps.
References CrewAI and LangGraph for multi-agent roles and stateful agent workflows.
Includes quality gates for agent logic, tools, memory, orchestration, and evaluation.
limitations: Does not include runnable source code or framework-specific implementation files.
Depends on other named skills for detailed CrewAI, LangGraph, memory, and evaluation guidance.
Does not install dependencies, run tests, or execute agent frameworks.
Does not define security controls for tool permissions, sandboxing, or production deployment.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Agent Project
use_cases.description: Create a staged development plan that covers purpose, capabilities, tools, memory, and success metrics.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Multi-Agent Design
use_cases.description: Break a multi-agent system into roles, communication paths, orchestration steps, and test points.

use_cases.title: Review Agent Readiness
use_cases.description: Use the workflow phases and quality gates to check whether an agent is ready for evaluation.

prompt_templates.title: Start Agent Planning
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new agent idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan an AI agent for [task]. Define the purpose, core capabilities, required tools, memory needs, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Single Agent
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate implementation planning for one autonomous agent.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to design a single autonomous agent for [domain]. Recommend a framework, agent logic, tool interfaces, memory approach, and behavior tests.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Agent System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for role-based agent collaboration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a multi-agent system for [goal]. Define agent roles, coordination rules, task delegation, communication flow, and evaluation criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Orchestrate and Evaluate Agents
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow design with state, memory, and quality gates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to create an orchestration and evaluation plan for [agent system]. Include state management, persistence, memory retrieval, edge cases, and quality gates.

output_examples.input: Plan a support triage agent for a SaaS help desk.
output_examples.output: A phased plan covering agent purpose, ticket classification tools, short-term context, long-term customer memory, and evaluation scenarios.

output_examples.input: Design a research assistant with multiple specialized agents.
output_examples.output: A role map with researcher, verifier, summarizer, and coordinator agents plus communication flow and delegation checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Evaluate whether an agent workflow is ready for launch.
output_examples.output: A readiness checklist for logic, tool integration, memory behavior, orchestration tests, edge cases, and measurable success criteria.

best_practices: Start with agent purpose and measurable success metrics before selecting frameworks.
Design tool interfaces and error handling before connecting external systems.
Evaluate memory, orchestration, and edge cases before production use.
anti_patterns: Starting with a framework before defining the agent role and task boundaries.
Adding long-term memory without retrieval tests and privacy controls.
Skipping multi-agent coordination tests when agents delegate work to each other.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps plan AI agents, multi-agent systems, orchestration workflows, tool integration, memory systems, and evaluation steps.

faq.question: Does it generate a complete agent application?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and prompts, but it does not include runnable application code.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it mention?
faq.answer: It references CrewAI for multi-agent systems and LangGraph for stateful agent workflows.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it cover agent memory?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes steps for short-term memory, long-term memory, entity memory, and retrieval testing.

faq.question: Does it include security review guidance?
faq.answer: No. Add separate checks for tool permissions, data handling, sandboxing, and deployment controls.
